## Reading: the surplus of 1 is a transferred card — not a race, not a walk gap · `domain:skills` seat 1 · `session_01V1upgJbYCZ5xed9pEQF4Tz` (os-steve) · 2026-10-18T16:33Z

⛔ Not a claim; no dev dispatched. A `tooling` card whose first line names no admission door is not a dispatch candidate for this lane (execution-duties 〈候选与批次〉), so this comment names the cause instead — the card's first "Done when".

**Measured on the archive branch `board-archive` (`board/manifest.json` at three snapshot commits) and the two failed runs' job logs:**

| snapshot commit | run | board `open_issues_count` − open PRs = expected | archived open issues − `gone_ledger` 59 | `count_check` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `4d350daea` (2026-10-18T02:30Z) | 39090231694, green | 113 − 6 = 107 | 166 − 59 = 107 | `ok` |
| `17aaded04` (2026-10-18T08:26Z) | 39111361975, red | 119 − 8 = 111 | 171 − 59 = 112 | `surplus` 1 |
| `67fcdbc70` (2026-10-18T14:19Z) | 39135375245, red | 117 − 7 = 110 | 170 − 59 = 111 | `surplus` 1 |

- Both red manifests carry `walk/delta/complete = true`, `freshness/verdict = fresh`, `shortfall = 0`, `surplus = 1` — the same +1 six hours apart across two complete walks. A race with board churn (reading 1) would not reproduce the identical surplus twice, and a walk gap (reading 2) reads as a shortfall, never a surplus. The job log of run 39135375245 prints the verdict in words: 「SURPLUS of 1 — the archive holds 170 open issue(s) where the board reports only 110. Records this archive carries are no longer on the board: destroyed with an account, deleted, or transferred.」
- The record: the archive's open issues at `67fcdbc70`, minus the 59 ledger numbers, minus the live open set (read 2026-10-18T16:28Z), leaves twelve numbers. Eleven are cards closed after that commit (each read live: `closed`, `closed_at` later than 14:19Z). The twelfth, **#24176**, answers HTTP 301 at this repository — a transferred issue. The archive holds it `open` at `4d350daea` (02:30Z; `domain:services` · `priority:p3` · `pm:retriage`; last updated 2026-10-18T00:39Z), and the board no longer counted it at 08:26Z — exactly the window in which the surplus appeared.
- So the count check did its job. A transferred number that the ledger does not carry reads as a surplus of 1 on every run until it does (`scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs` header: a number deliberately left destroyed or moved to another repo goes in `gone.json`, which is the ONLY way to quiet it). Neither fix in the card's "Done when" applies: ⛔ no code change, ⛔ no gate, ⛔ no retry.

**The one quieting action, and whose it is by precedent:** `board/gone.json` on `board-archive` has a single author, the maintainer (commit `9efc90299`, 2026-10-12, 59 rows, each noted 「accepted as gone by the maintainer」). The row this case needs, in the ledger's own shape (`readGoneLedger` accepts a bare number or a row with a note):

```json
{ "number": 24176, "note": "transferred: 301 at objectstack-ai/objectstack on 2026-10-18; archived open at 02:30Z, off the board by 08:26Z" }
```

Maintainer-action: append the row above for 24176 to `board/gone.json` on the `board-archive` branch (one fast-forward commit, as commit 9efc90299 did) — done when the next scheduled Board Snapshot run's manifest reads `count_check.verdict = ok` and the run is green

State in this act: `pm:queue` → `pm:awaiting-maintainer` (the decision is made; one hand-written ledger row remains, by the ledger's own precedent). If the maintainer would rather have a seat's dev commit the row directly to `board-archive`, one word on this card and the skills seat dispatches it; until then no seat writes to that branch. Every scheduled run stays red (exit 2, the archive still committed) until the row lands — a known red, not a new finding, and not reading 2.

## Done: three transfer rows in `board/gone.json`, `count_check` reads `ok`, run green

The maintainer approved this in chat: 「可以：#24351 三行一起追加（24176、24525、25584），推送后手动跑一次 Board Snapshot，读到 ok 就关卡。」

- **Commit:** `179fa1a2d120cb2af48ca0e1bd620b7ea1b298e4` on `board-archive`. It is one fast-forward on top of `aea59df2` (no force), shaped like `9efc90299`, and the diff adds exactly three `{number, note}` entries in number order. The ledger now holds 62 rows.
- **Run:** https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40152681751 (`workflow_dispatch`, success). It committed snapshot `ad22f946` (2026-10-25T02:00:04Z).
- **Verdict:** `count_check` = `{"verdict":"ok","expected":121,"archived":183,"gone_ledger":62,"shortfall":0,"surplus":0}`.

**Why three rows, not one.** By the 2026-10-24T20:21Z snapshot the surplus had grown past this card's single number:
- 1 from 10-18T08:26Z;
- 2 from 10-20T02:31Z;
- 3 from 10-24T08:26Z.

I took the archive's open issues outside the ledger (125) and removed the live open set (122, REST, 2026-10-25). That left 14 numbers. Each one was read live:

| number | where it is now | surplus from |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 24176 | transferred to objectstack-ai/cloud#2988 | 10-18T08:26Z |
| 24525 | transferred to objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 | 10-20T02:31Z |
| 25584 | transferred to objectstack-ai/objectui#13436 | 10-24T08:26Z |

The other 11 were closed in this repository after the 20:21Z snapshot, and the delta walk refreshes them. They were left out of the ledger on purpose, so the count check can still raise an alarm the next time an issue disappears.

Closing as completed, per the action line.
